coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Only 2 of 18 ground-truth items are matched at a broad level: QA as a task category and accuracy as an outcome measure (11%, rounded). The proposed experiment otherwise differs substantially from the reference design.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits the specified Mistral model, 4K window, GPU/precision settings, and fixed memory parameters. It replaces the required lookup conditions with different interventions, omitting decoding-only lookup and defining lookup-off as attention over all memory slots. Its representation methods do not specify representative tokens or mean unit key vectors. It substitutes other benchmarks for Retrieve.KV and Math.F, varies context length instead of fixing it at 12K, and does not specify task-wise Accuracy (%) as the common metric.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion is provided about the benefit of full memory lookup, the near-collapse of Retrieve.KV without lookup, or the advantage of representative tokens over mean representations.
